title: Faded Glitch Path of the Broken Anarchist
description: In a surreal psychedelic scene, three women with colorful braided hair and patched jackets stand on a rocky cliff edge pointing toward a glowing circular portal in the sky. The portal contains a cracked moon face and a green alien holding a game cartridge, while two cats sit beside them watching a rollercoaster track that loops over an ocean toward a distant city.
prompt: A vibrant psychedelic illustration shows three women with green, blue, and white braided hair wearing black patched jackets standing on a broken cliff with two cats, one grey and one orange. They point toward a swirling purple and blue circular portal in the sky containing a cracked moon with a serene face and a green alien holding a game cartridge. A rollercoaster track loops dramatically over a wavy ocean toward a distant city with a water tower under a light sky.
